scripts.check: orb-plugin support --check SUPPORT.md && orb-plugin check . --source-dir src --out-dir . && orb-plugin check examples/frame --source-dir examples/frame/src --out-dir examples/frame
scripts.build: orb-plugin build . --source-dir src --out-dir . && orb-plugin build examples/frame --source-dir examples/frame/src --out-dir examples/frame
scripts.pack: orb-plugin pack . --source-dir src --out dist/scripted-ui-starter.orb-plugin.zip && orb-plugin pack examples/frame --source-dir examples/frame/src --out dist/custom-frame-starter.orb-plugin.zip
